sections.title: Habit and fruit
sections.text: Citrus maxima, the pomelo, is a spreading, sometimes thorny tree 5–15 m tall. Its leaves have winged petioles. The fruit is round to pear-shaped, often more than 10 cm across and up to about 30 cm, with a thick rind and yellow or pink flesh.

sections.title: Food and distinction
sections.text: The fruit is cultivated and eaten fresh. Pomelo is Citrus maxima; it should not be confused with grapefruit, Citrus × paradisi, a distinct hybrid. The plate shows the tree, leaves and large yellow fruit accurately.
